title: Cookie Build · Shop activation
description: Durable server-side aggregate counts. Anonymous GA web analytics is a separate consent-dependent population and must not be used as an automatic conversion denominator.

panels.title: Free sparkles · ever observed
panels.description: All-time distinct Minecraft accounts, including the initial baseline. Not a count of clicks or purchases; deletion of an account removes its contribution.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(sum(activated_accounts), 0) AS accounts FROM metrics.shop_activation_summary WHERE cosmetic_id = 'cookie_sparkle_trail'

panels.title: Free sparkles · currently equipped
panels.description: Current selection state, independent of the time picker. Unequipping reduces this count but does not erase the first observed activation.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(sum(equipped_accounts), 0) AS accounts FROM metrics.shop_equipped_current WHERE cosmetic_id = 'cookie_sparkle_trail'

panels.title: Linked shop accounts · current
panels.description: Distinct accounts with at least one unexpired, non-revoked shop session. This is a current stock, not a link event count or a funnel denominator.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(sum(linked_accounts), 0) AS accounts FROM metrics.shop_linked_current WHERE link_type = 'commerce_session'

panels.title: Subscriptions · current period
panels.description: Current billing periods not ended, including scheduled cancellation and past-due subscriptions until period end. Billing state is not proof of entitlement access. Live mode only.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(sum(subscriptions), 0) AS subscriptions FROM metrics.shop_subscriptions_current WHERE current_period AND status IN ('active', 'trialing', 'past_due')

panels.title: First observed free activations · account edition
panels.description: New first observations after measurement began. Retries, re-equipping and web/game paths deduplicate by account and cosmetic. Java/Bedrock describes the Minecraft account, not browser or input device; unknown is retained. Full Europe/Paris calendar-day buckets, up to 180 days.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, edition AS metric, activated_accounts AS value FROM metrics.shop_activation_daily WHERE cosmetic_id = 'cookie_sparkle_trail' AND observed_source = 'selection' AND time >= date_trunc('day', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz, 'Europe/Paris') AND time <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz ORDER BY time

panels.title: Initial free selection baseline · separate
panels.description: Selections already present when the migration was applied, observed on that day. Their original acquisition date is unknown. Never add this series to post-launch acquisition totals.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, edition AS metric, activated_accounts AS value FROM metrics.shop_activation_daily WHERE cosmetic_id = 'cookie_sparkle_trail' AND observed_source = 'baseline' AND time >= date_trunc('day', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz, 'Europe/Paris') AND time <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz ORDER BY time

panels.title: Cosmetics currently equipped
panels.description: Current stock per cosmetic and account edition. Paid selections require a currently valid entitlement; duplicate entitlement sources never double count. An account can appear under several cosmetics. Edition was recorded at its first observed selection.

targets.rawSql: SELECT cosmetic_id AS cosmetic, edition, equipped_accounts AS accounts FROM metrics.shop_equipped_current ORDER BY cosmetic_id, edition

panels.title: First observations · all cosmetics
panels.description: Account/cosmetic pairs, not global unique players. Baseline and new observations stay separate. Daily Europe/Paris buckets; 180-day chart window.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, cosmetic_id || ' / ' || observed_source AS metric, sum(activated_accounts) AS value FROM metrics.shop_activation_daily WHERE time >= date_trunc('day', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz, 'Europe/Paris') AND time <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz GROUP BY time, cosmetic_id, observed_source ORDER BY time

panels.title: Checkout orders created
panels.description: Unique live order rows attributed to creation day. Reusing the same order is not another attempt. Checkout-session presence is the current state of that cohort; not a separate session creation time. Anonymous and linked payer populations are mixed: no ratio with GA traffic or linked accounts.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, created_orders AS "Created orders", checkout_session_orders AS "Orders with checkout session" FROM metrics.shop_orders_daily WHERE time >= date_trunc('day', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz, 'Europe/Paris') AND time <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz ORDER BY time

panels.title: Paid orders
panels.description: Live orders first paid on each Europe/Paris day. Renewals belong to payment receipts, not new orders. Later refunds do not erase the original paid-order count.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, paid_orders AS "First-paid orders" FROM metrics.shop_paid_orders_daily WHERE time >= date_trunc('day', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz, 'Europe/Paris') AND time <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz ORDER BY time

panels.title: EUR receipts · current refund adjustment
panels.description: Live payment receipts including subscription renewals. Refunds are cumulative current amounts attributed to the original payment day, so historical points can change. Before Stripe fees; includes VAT; not accounting revenue, refund-date cash flow or net settled disputes.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, gross_cents / 100.0 AS "Gross paid TTC", refunded_cents / 100.0 AS "Refunds attributed to payment day", refund_adjusted_cents / 100.0 AS "Paid TTC less current refunds" FROM metrics.shop_receipts_daily WHERE currency = 'EUR' AND time >= date_trunc('day', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz, 'Europe/Paris') AND time <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz ORDER BY time

panels.title: Subscriptions · current billing state
panels.description: Current subscription records by Stripe status, scheduled cancellation and unended current period. Independent of time picker. Live orders only.

targets.rawSql: SELECT status, cancel_at_period_end, current_period, subscriptions FROM metrics.shop_subscriptions_current ORDER BY status, cancel_at_period_end, current_period
